text: The food smelled good when I got it, but the pizza was cold and there was a short brown hair on the cheese bites (both my roommate and I have long blonde hair) :/

WOW!  A New York hot dog in Reno, Nevada?  YES!!!  The dog is perfectly cooked, the casing has a SNAP when you bite into it and the toppings are of your choice always.  We found this new restaurant about a month ago or so and it wasn't open so we patiently waited and descended on it last week.  We were so happy with our dogs and the terrific fries, crispy and hot, that we came back the very next day to continue our exploration of this menu.  We were not disappointed.  The dogs are absolutely terrific and you can purchase a package of them to take home and cook.  Very happy to have found this place and the gals working there are friendly, happy to be living in Reno and welcoming to all customers.  Easy parking and access to this restaurant.  We love it.

This is absolutely one of my favorite places.  Nice atmosphere with delicious food from the egg rolls to shrimp dumplings.  So much to choose from.  Its 50 minutes away from home, but well with the trip.  Keep up the good work.

I've never been to such a horribly executed, slow, Chick-fil-A in my life. I ordered my meal for pickup at 6:45 and I'm still in line 20 min later. No one outside to speed things along... Plus when you get in the drive through line you're blocked in by cones and can't get out. I had a feeling I shouldn't have come to this one.
THANK YOU FOR CHANGING THE CARPET!! Now that the carpet is new the SMELL IS GONE! I prayed to the Culver's gods and it's no longer an issue. You can have a butter burger and not have your nose burn!

For a food spot at the airport, this wasn't bad, but I don't know that I would choose it again. My little salad was $14 and it was sad. It was served on a side plate which I wouldn't have minded if it were described as a side salad. The chicken had been warmed and it all tasted pretty good, so can't complain about that. My server only stopped by twice - to take my order and to deliver the check before I was even finished eating so that irked me a bit. It was around 8pm on a Saturday and not super busy so I don't understand why I needed to be rushed out, maybe because I didn't order wine. I suppose I'm giving three stars mostly because this is one of the better options in that terminal and I typically like Vino Volos in other airports, but this one was a bit lacking.

LOVE this new place!! It is less than 10 min from my work so I have brought a couple work visitors here for dinner. The simplicity of the menu and the variety in choices to really make it your own is what I love most! You choose your broth base, and any other Addis's you want to make it spicers, more flavorful etc are available to choose from. There is a moving belt with tons of food choices from meat, veggies, seafood, tofu, etc. there is something for everyone! This is a fun experience that allows you to choose what you already know you like and try new things without committing to a full meal. I got to try frog legs! But also able to choose lamb, beef, crab, fish, broccoli, etc. great spot! I will Continue coming back!

The Food is a disgrace to Mexican food it like $15 dollars for nachos witch is soggy chips with fake nacho cheese on it and when we asked for real cheese the y just sprinkled some cheese on top and didn't even bother to melt it or take off the nacho cheese

Excellent pizza shop - they have a huge variety of pizzas by the slice (at least 20!). Fantastic options, friendly service, and a great large dining room to enjoy it. Also has a coke freestyle machine for drinks

Just like your high school cafeteria. Mediocre food. Disjointed and confused service. End of meal accompanied by crashing clean up kitchen noises and staff clearing everything off the tables around you. And they don'r close for an hour. Better to eat dinner at Krispy Kreme. Total dump. Move on.

I drive past this restaurant everyday on the way home and I regret not stopping here earlier. I came at 4 and they were having a happy hour that included both food and drink. All the dishes listed were only $6, so I got the BLTA salad and mushroom ravioli. They both were incredibly DELICIOUS. There's a very cute outdoor seating area where you can bring your dogs, too. I highly suggest stopping by if you haven't before do NOT skip out on the mushroom ravioli. It's 10/10 delicious.

Their tuna grinders are pretty incredible (usually not fishy, b/c I hate fishy & we doctor it up a little if it is); but last night's was on another level altogether!! Onions were a little burnt w/out even being requested that way, cause I've never had burnt onions (that I always LOVE on a cheesesteak) on a tuna grinder; but boy they were,/////it was, GOOD! The italian hoagie was SUCH A SURPRISE because it was SOOO AMAZING!!! I suspect it was b/c there was, (& I didn't inspect it) but, I think there was a hot meat on it & it musta been a hot GABA-GHOUL (haha or GOOL) or as ALL the MEDI-GANZZZZZ call it "CAP-Ihhh-COLA" (actually spelled Capicola). Just 2 FABULOUS sandwiches!!! To say we ENJOYED is an understatement! They also have good pizzas, salads, (especially The Special Mix salad w/boursin cheese, craisins & walnuts w/a delicious vinaigrette dressing), chicken wings, etc. The tuna grinders are just our most belov-ed & the hoagie (which we don't usually order here) is certainly a stand-out & a new favorite. 


Side Note: We get BOTH sandwiches with NOOO green peppers. Ya, they put green peppers on both their Italian hoagies & tuna grinders unless you request them without. To be clear, I LOVE  ALOT of diff kinds of peppers; Hot peppers (long hots, cherry peppers, hoagie spread-finely diced hots, etc) & Sweet peppers in oil (both green & red; especially LOVE when they're a little brown or burnt but they don't hafta be for me 2 Luv them); but I do NOT like raw green or red pe
First time here and very impressed. Food is soooo good! Great drinks! Service is also great . Definitely will be back !
I've ordered a few times over the past months and have been happy with everything! Pad Thai, mock sesame chicken, steamed vegetables are all very tasty.

The staff is absolutely amazing. They are kind, respectful, give amazing service and are absolutely honoring the social distancing laws. 

We got....

chili burger, it was perfectly cooked, delicious peppers, Gorgonzola and the portion was right on. It came with rosemary parm fries, that were hot and crispy. 

Margarita pizza with half pepperonis. The dough was flavorful and had a great texture. We are generally not flat bread pizza people, but this one was the perfect ratio of dough, sauce & ingredients. 

We will order again and recommend to friends. Thank you for the lovely service, especially in this strange time. 5/17/2020 :)

A worker/waiter harassed my wife for staying there for too long and not tipping sufficiently.
 ***She tipped 20%***  
They ordered 2 buckets of beers and 2 cocktails each between her and a friend...bump this place.

Harry's has always been my special occasion place my whole life. I would be a regular if I still lived in the neighborhood. The service is always amazing, food is great, atmosphere is perfect. They have went above and beyond with the new covid life during when they were only open for take out. I have a wonderful collection of mason jars that I plan to put to good use because I love jars and cocktails haha. 

My only gripe right now is the outdoor seating. Hear me out, I am not taking away a star for this because I know restaurants need to make room for people in a limited space, etc. I took my little brother out to eat today and our hostess nicely accepted our desire to not be sat back to back with others. I'm one of those paranoid ones about the virus. They weren't busy so I didn't feel bad, normally I wouldn't dare messing with rotation. We were seated in a far corner, which I felt bad about for our sever (made sure not to run her and tip 25%). But if someone were to be seated next to us it would be back to back. You could touch the table. Even closer than their normal indoor set up. I get they need to make up for loss of business and also make sure the servers get plenty of tables to make up for shitty tippers, but yikes. I'm happy I went at a slow time otherwise it would be way too close for comfort in a pandemic where the minimum distance is 6 foot. I always order with my mask on then try to put my napkin up when the server comes by out of respect. There's gotta be a way

It was our first dine in experience post Covid 19. We started our evening with salad. The salad had a funky fish taste. We were both hoping it was because it had anchovies in the dressing but we can't confirm. Neither of us got sick, so I'm assuming it was supposed to taste like that. I had the lobster ravioli. It was decent. My only major complaint is the prices are that of a fancy restaurant and to me it's pretty much on par with the Olive Garden. Not terrible but underwhelming.
Been here a couple of times and it's always busy, so probably best to make reservations any time you plan to go.  Great food, good service, never been disappointed.
Not that great of food, nothing special, the person at the front was extremely rude, food is overpriced.

I know chipotle generally has a cult following, I'm not sure why. This is the only location I've ever been to and the food was meh. I normally would never give them a 1 star, but their employees are literally the worse.  I was there twice and both times they were all extremely rude and slow and acted as thou they were doing me a favor. There are plenty of other options with generally nicer employees.

The staff was extremely rude here. The wait staff at the snack bar did not greet us or say anything to us at all. She rolled her eyes and sighed when I requested napkins and silverware. The manager was also rude almost refusing to put up the guards for an 11 year old because it's only for "under 10". He was condescending and rude as well. When talking to him about the experience and how it was ruined but the terrible customer service he responded insincerely and sarcastically. I have been to many bowling alleys in Tucson and this is my first time ever having an experience this bad. The place was great but won't be returning due to the staff.
Filet Tips Oscar and sherried mushrooms were super good. The service was also amazing, definitely will be going back.
That girl so beautiful. The food was amazing too. So was the margarita. Tons of leftovers. The hostess hailey was fantastic.
Great ambience food was not the best if you're looking for authentic Mexican food this is not the place. More Tex-Mex style

this is one of those spots that you pick up to order and they make it really quickly in the back over the top stove. Better than Panda express I would say and way more heavier portions! 

As the store name says it's a noodle bar servin lots of noodles and burgers on a late night shift. We tried the wonton soup.. horrible. the sinapore noodles were delish. The chow fun was decent. the mongolian beef was very salty and mostly consisted of onions, rice on the other hand was good. Their fried rice was alright. And their steamed veggies were delish! 

Will def keep you guys in mind if I want a quick, fast, cheap, filling meal in reno!
Huge portion and reasonable price, very delicious food. Been carrying out many times. Friendly staff.

I use Pizza Plus often for work events. My team is 6 people with a few extra on occasion. They have several meal deals that work for my team size and preferences. I usually call in an order and then go pick it up. The last few pick ups (post remodel) have not been as smooth as before. Lately they give me a time estimate, I arrive around then and then I still wait 10 - 15 minutes. I'm also surprised at the cost of the sides of ranch and nitro sauce. For the size, it seems pretty exaggerated.

For group needs for work Pizza Plus will still be a go to. For my personal pizza cravings, I don't see myself coming here.

Eh. Shrug. It's fine. 
The decor is BEYOND cute and the staff is extremely nice. 
The food is as I said "fine". The queso doesn't come with chips which bums me out and they only give you two measly flour tortillas with it. All the tacos were made SO sloppy with the ingredients all to one side or a big hunk o beans on one end and all the cheese on the other. The tortillas for the tacos and burritos seem to be the same size so you end up with all this extra tortilla on your tacos. (maybe use them for your loose queso?) The wait for food is very long and the management is pretty unapologetic when we complained about it saying "yup it's taking us about 40-50 min to make tacos on the line" like it was a brag. 
Hoping some of these kinks get worked out as they chug along but I currently don't intend to head back that way. 
The Topo Chico was cold.

Came back here recently on an IKEA run. It was during Covid and we came at lunch. We sat outside and ordered burgers and a few beers. The burgers were actually better than before! Worth the almost 200 mile round trip to Tampa

This visit was the second or third time I've been there so I figured that I should take a minute to give a review!   We went for lunch, which was expensive, but we ordered three dishes so I guess that is to be expected. 

Service - fast and friendly
Food - High quality and well-sized portions
Atmosphere - Clean, classy and authentic

We ordered a combination appetizer platter for $13.95.  All items were delicious.  
I had the beef curry noodle at medium (3) spicy and loved it.  It comes in a bowl and is a but soupy but incredibly tasty.  I like spice so will order a level 4 next time.  $15.95.
My son ordered the Crispy Three which had shrimp and calamari and something else which I can't remember at this time.  I'm not keen on fish sauce so I didn't like this dish but he loved it.  $14.95

We had enough left over for dinner that night, which was great.  I added some extra rice and noodles and we each had a generous dinner.  

All in all, it was a great visit and I look forward to coming back!

Bourbon branch is a western restaurant bar. I really enjoyed the atmosphere. The food was delicious. I ordered  beef nachos, calamari and wings. The drinks  and shots was good also. They also offer great variety menu

Ordered mini pastries for a party.  Did not know that Patrick Gauthron, founder and past owner of Aux Petit Delice sold the bakery.  I've ordered from Patrick for 30 years.  He did all the cakes, pastries, etc for me when I worked for the Philadelphia Phillies I? the Owner's Dining Room.  The pastries I got yesterday were horrible!  Quality was horrible, packaging was horrible.  Since when do you stack and tape four boxes on top of each other.  They caved in and smashed the bottom box.  The Napoleons were the worst - DRIED out, no cream, the worst I've ever tasted.  I spent $200 on inferior pastries, I could have gotten better from Acme.  I have heard negative comments recently about Aux Petit Delice but blew them off.  Now I know why --new owner who doesn't have it.

We just did Caleb's Curbside dining during this Carona Virus epidemic  and my husband and I would both say "Run don't walk" to do the same.  We had a meal that was both delicious and so satisfying to our heart and soul at this isolating time.  We had the turkey dinner.  It consisted of beautiful white meat turkey which was so tasty and also well seasoned and very moist.  It also came with a very large portion of mixed, fresh vegetables in a medley that included red peppers, peas, carrots and several others which were cooked perfectly and again seasoned just right, not at all bland.  We also had mashed potatoes and my favorite, sage bread stuffing.  I'm a stuffing aficionado and this was among the best bread stuffing I've ever had.  I wanted my turkey without gravy and my husband with gravy and Caleb accommodated us both.  The process was completely easy; we ordered it by phone, pulled up with our car at the hour we ordered it be ready and it was delivered to our car piping hot.  We came home and had a beautiful, happy, Thanksgiving dinner in the midst of this isolating time.  We are Thankful to you Caleb for doing this for us, Linda and Gary Collins

This is my 2nd time going to this establishment.  The 1st time I thought it was great.  The 2nd time not so much.  I ordered the catfish and got mashed potatoes and Mac and cheese on the side.  The fish was ok.  The mac n cheese was not good at all to me.  The mashed potatoes were good.   My son ordered their steak burger and he liked it for the most part.  The staff is iffy.  Some of the staff was nice, some were really rude.  It seems when the restaurant is busy, they have a hard time with keeping up. When we got there we were seated by one of the ppl on the staff then it took 15 minutes before someone came to ask if we'd been helped.  My biggest issue came when I took my 6 yr to the restroom and came back to the table and his food was gone.  When I told one of the staff what had happened, she cut me off and said "well if the table was empty then they assumed you were gone" my response was "well I have a 6yr that needed to go to the restroom, you could see by the items I left on the table I was coming back. "  they ended up replacing the burger but we had to wait another 15 minutes for that. Overall I would come back, they didn't lose me completely but today was definitely an "off day" for the restaurant in my opinion.  Oh and the lemonade is probably the best I've had in a while.
Love this place,great service always welcoming! The food options are great and always rich in flavor! The fries go perfect with Gyros. I always recommend people try this place its great!

I enjoy Union Jack Pub, but don't go here often.  It's nothing special, but is well liked across the neighborhood.  

I do love that they have a large beer selection.  They don't have a ton on tap, but they have quite a few, and what they lack for there they make up for in bottles.  The bartenders were helpful in making our selection.  

Deep dish pizza does take a while to make.  That is something people need to be aware of when they come here.  On my first visit I did not know this, it was late at night, and we were starving.  So the 45 minute wait for food was not ideal.  Our server did not tell us this either, so if my husband hadn't known, it would have been easy to assume the wait was poor service.  However, it's not their fault there!

Wow!! Ordered the Taco Tuesday special (3 tacos, chips, salsa) for $9.00. Thai chicken was super. Hubby ordered the tuna tacos. They were stuffed with tons of seared chunks of tuna. Very impressed, can't wait for Tuesday to roll around again!!

Against my better judgement I revisited this store. I should have known better by now, but I really wanted some cajun rice.

I found a bone in my boneless tender. A bone. In a boneless tender. Not gristle or a tiny fragment, but a bone. The tenders were stale and chewy anyhow without biting down on a hard bone.

This place is disgusting. Rude, nasty, disgusting.

If there is a lower star it would be minus.  A reservation for Alex was made yesterday for my friend's birthday dinner.  Our party included 12 African American females all professionals with various jobs. As we entered the restuarant we were not approached about dress code.  We weren't told anything until the last 3 of our party arrived dark complexioned and natural hair.  One had a tube top dress, elegant and the red tinted Bush.  The manager Brenda met them at the door and told one of the ladies "Your shirt was too small we have a dress code." She let them in anyway.  As we were seated in a group of 12 Brenda came to the table clapping her hands and speaking loudly, "The COV19 guidelines were explained that only 10 can sit together." Now why they sat all 12 us together to be embarrassed by Brenda turning other diners head toward us.  Alex moved away to a smaller table with her boyfriend so guidelines were followed. Our server John Carlos took our drink orders except one which 30 mins later the bartender brought over.  John returned 15mins later to take appetizers order and an hour later our meal orders were taken.  Meal while the BIRTHDAY Queen and her boyfriend had already finished eating their entire meal.  Our meals took another hour to come.  We ordered meals that were quick to prepare.  Now John Carlos service was the worst after food was served her never returned to table to see if any beverages or other items were needed.  We're not sure if the fact we have a toddler

The Coronet is a great spot if you like the food of Europe.  I'm a little shocked at the 4 star Yelp.  I went before 5pm during their snack menu, and everything was excellent.  I had the frites and a salmon plate with baguette.  Pro tip: the coffee here is very good.  Just as good as any specialty coffee location.  I recommend you sit outside on the sunny patio with a couple cortados.
This is our go to Mexican Restaurant on the south side! We have tried many and always go back to El Jalapeño!

The Ice House is definitely the spot for breakfast. Lunch/dinner is average but breakfast is where it's at here. Homemade OJ, donuts, and Jellies - AMAZING. The Oh My Homefries are also worth the pennies to add to get them with any meal here.

Loved the smoked turkey and unlimited fountain drinks. The price is right, tables are plentiful and the ambience is perfect. It's all about ordering your food and taking it to the table of your choice. A+

Well, I love cubans and hispanic food.  We were almost struck while walking by their employee in a dark minivan with a handicap carrier on the back before we got to the restaurant, then we realized he worked at La Cubanita.  We wont be back.

If you're looking for an unassuming breakfast spot with good prices and good food, this is your place! We are here for the first time today and I can see us becoming regulars. The decor isn't fancy or trendy, but the service is friendly and fast. 

The pancakes and waffles were delicious, as were the eggs, potatoes, and sausage. 

We've driven by this place 1000 times and had no idea it was tucked away in the strip mall. I'm glad we discovered this local spot for breakfast.

Very retro feel. Beverly's portion of 118 Ave has a small town Main Street feel and Take 5 fits right in. The donuts are good and they other other items you might expect from an independent coffee shop. If you're in the area, stop by or consider the Italian Bakery a few blocks away as an alternative.

If your looking for great drinks, food, and service, Mifflin is the spot! Between the awesome rotating draft list featuring the best local breweries to the staples of the food menu like the brisket cheesesteak, it is a place that is sure to please.

So good!!!!!! Was excited to try based on the reviews and was really happy that we did. Got the Tonkatsu Ramen, Pad Thai, Thai Tea, and Butterfly Tea. All delicious!! The owners are so kind and the restaurant itself is adorable and super clean. Will be back soon!

My good friend and I came up for the weekend to celebrate a big change in his life and our excitement for the first time in Reno and the Silver Legacy was squashed by the rude staff.  If you have an underlying condition that prohibits you to wear a mask, be prepared to be severely harassed. Staff has even asked me what my condition is.  That's illegal and that will be met with a lawsuit against the Silver Legacy and its parent company.  

Our room which is supposed to be a suite is nothing more than a glorified room with a king size bed.  Yippee.  The tub in the middle of the room should have jets in it to make this a spa suite. 

The room was extremely hot and it took almost all night for the weak A/C system to somewhat cool it down.  

I dread leaving this room in fear of being harassed by uneducated sheep.  I may just cut my trip short and leave.

Not bad for the price.
Got the spicy salmon and tuna and spicy crab rolls. Pretty tasty. Very nice rice to fish ratio.
Restaurant itself has nice decor nice atmosphere.

I wish I could rate 0 stars, I guess the only thing that would permit a one star is the manager did talk to me and was sweet, I do think they do the best they can but need training. I was super disappointed. I arrived one hour before they closed to get 1 steak quesadilla and one veggie quesadilla. I don't eat meat, it was for someone els and they said they shut down the steak early so that wasn't an option which was fine by me because after looking at the food it was DISGUSTING the entire kitchen was filthy. They were touching my quesadilla with dirty gloves that I watched the employee touch multiple unsanitary things. I then changed my order to just 2 plain quesadillas. I go to pay and she says $17.78!!! For 2 PLAIN QUESADILLA WITH BARELY ANY CHEESE sloppy thrown together and NO SIDES, no rice, no tomatoes, guacamole nothing. See my pictures for reference. They don't do justice I should have taken a photo of the floor and counter. Also while plating up the food and chopping I think they forget this isn't a game. So sloppy and gross. I can't get over the fact it was over $17 dollars I left without it because I was scared to even eat it after the gloves touched it.

Every order is a new adventure here. The menu is so expansive, and for an Asian food lover like myself, that means endless opportunity. 

I try not to order the same dishes twice, but the food here is so good, I can't help but have a few favorites. The popcorn chicken must be included in every meals the light and crunchy coating is seasoned with some sweet warm spices that make the chicken delicious all on its own, but if you dip it in the sauce, it's next level. I also have a hard time skipping over dishes in the basil sauce, which usually is chicken, but this time I tried the king mushrooms. These are meaty and delicious, stir fried in a slightly sweet, spicy and savory sauce studded with whole cloves of garlic, big pieces of ginger and chili!

The Authentic Taiwanese section is always good for a few foodie thrills. This time around we tried the house style braised pork belly. I'd say this one was good, but I missed the sauce and braised veg I enjoy with other preparations.

My favorite section of the menu is the "appetizers". New items are always added here, and they're typically great. This time we went with the braised Napa cabbage (so savory, delicious, and full of umami) and the omelette with salty daikon. Both home runs. The sweetness of the egg mixed with seasoning and the salty pickled daikon was a great contrast to a lot of the richer dishes we ordered, and adding the leftovers to fried rice was amazing! 

If you haven't been here, you absolutely must go. Check out

Amazing Pizza! 

I was speechless after I took the first bite out of both of these pizzas. I've traveled to Italy and had pizza, tried Chicago pizza and I would've never expected that my favorite pizza place would be in Nashville. We ordered these pizzas before going out to the honky tonks and it was incredible before going out and just as good when we came back home as left overs. 

Unfortunately I don't live in Tennessee so I can't eat this as often as I'd like but I really encourage that you do. I'll be thinking of their pizza throughout the rest of my life. 

My friend picked up the pizza so I can't comment on the ambience or service but based on taste alone, 5/5.

Philly is full of surprises. Indeblue was a great surprise in the middle of downtown.  Atmosphere was warm and intimate with low lighting and Earth toned walls.  Service was on point, helpful, quick and polite. The courses moved easily in and out of our table. We are the  chef's tasting and got to try five items plus dessert for $45.  Every single thing tasted authentically Indian (my Indian wife was with me) and perfectly made.  
My only point of disappointment was the cocktails. We tried the Anjeer and the Bombay Muraba and both recipes were hollow, too sweet and lacked alcohol.  I recommend sticking with your trusted cocktail instead.
Overall, extremy good experience and high recommendation.

Food is not what it use to be.
Wings lack sauce,  fries what fries, almost not existence. 
I don't know what happened but it not a great idea to go spend so much money for a " happy meal".
Please take care of your customers, or someone else will!!

Burgers were fire my boy ate 4 double stacks. Grown man shit. Everyone in the place was nice. Burgers are were so damn good I got the beef sweats. Going to have to bring some skanks here soon for some burgers.
Worst place ever! Breakfast served cold twice and took 20+ minutes just to take our order even when that the manager wanted to remake the food still came out cold!!!

I have been wanting to try Nick's for awhile now.  Glad I did!
Pizza was very good.  Well done just how I prefer.
My son had the chicken cheesesteak and mozzarella sticks.  Both very good.
Will return.

I was in the area so I decided to see if it was getting a lot of attention due to the grand opening and the buy one get one free... it was around 1:30 and from the outside it didn't seem too busy.
Inside thee were a few sitting at the tables and a few in line.
I followed the menu ordering and got the two beef bul go gi's... to go...

I got it back home and was surprised there was a miso soup that came with it?  Wasn't in the mood for soup, and it didn't go with the meal...(maybe to save the soup and containers they should ask if you want it)
Hubby came home early ( or maybe cause I sent a pic of it)... it was tasty, healthy but I had more rice than meat.

Updated review 12/15/19

I have to thank my Korean Netflix tv show I just started watching, that made me crave some Korean dishes..
Unfortunately, my go to place is closed on Sunday's..
So here we are!

We both ordered the beef bowls and an appetizer of Korean wings.

It took a while to get the food, but it was better than our first visit. The only complaint would be the miso soup, was very tepid.... bummer..but other than that the bowl satisfied my craving.
I get food from here delivered all the time. It's amazing and delicious. The naan is always absolute perfection!

Came in for dinner at 8-830 on a Friday . Had a short wait to sit outside . By the time we got our drinks and order apps our table was ready . Service and food was on point . Very old school French style decor . And made you feel like you were in France with the way the tables faced the street to people watch .  Would definitely check out there restaurant group again .
Omg!! Went on a Thursday night for my friend's bday and we had soooooo much fun. The Dj played all the right music
I'm giving it 4 stars for the pleasant service and ambiance. The food definitely needed more seasoning/sauce/spice just everything.
This is by FAR the best restaurant I've been to in a long time. Plenty to choose from, perfect portion sizes and unique menu items. Absolutely AMAZING food!

I understand things are different since the COVID 19 outbreak, but this place should not have opened. Food cold, no service at all, 4 oz tiny margaritas in a mini mason jar and still charging $10.50?? Seriously??! And the taste was awful.!!  A side of jalapeños weren't even muddled for flavor!!!  If your going to open during this pandemic , and adjust your quality and quantity you need to adjust prices accordingly and you need to  have a way better plan in place!! After spending $60 For one person I was still hungry and thirsty. Left and went to Irish 31 around the corner for full service along with social  distancing and good food. Bartaco,,,, you need to shut it down till you have a better plan in place or you will lose every customer you ever had!
Best Mediterranean food on the Westbank! Hands down! I call to order and they have my food ready everytime!

I love having a delicious bbq place nearby! 
The pulled pork was perfection!  
The potato salad is a sweet mustard base.  
Texas toast is buttery and delicious.  
My favorite sauce was def. the tractor grease, full of flavor! Sweet and tangy.  The To Go packets are huge!
The only complaint is there was more sauce than brisket!  Not quite a sandwich.  Maybe have an option to add to those who want a whole sandwich.  
Or I'll just stick with the pulled pork! 
I will definitely be returning!

Courteous staff, welcoming vibe, and a classy look. Did I mention the absolutely spine-tingling steak skewers?? If I hadn't been in public, the plate would've been licked clean. Absolutely outstanding flavor and I will most definitely be returning to this fine establishment.
My favorite place for sushi! It was very fresh and the service was great! I also had the chicken lo mein. I will be back for the happy hour!

I arrived knowing exactly what I wanted, unusual for me.  I asked for coffee, water and extra napkins to start.   It took a while but I got my coffee and some water.  The server forgot about the napkins.  

I ordered my late breakfast.  Then waited.  After I finished my second cup of coffee I wondered.  The guy next to me who arrived several minutes after me got his food.  

I finally got my food.  As I got my food the guy at the next table was getting his check.  

The food was mostly good.  I had steak and eggs.  The steak was very over cooked.  I mean brutal, but I guess no one really comes to IHOP for the steak.  The eggs and pancakes were good. 

My server seemed to disappear.  I saw other members of the staff hustling around, taking really good care of customers and cleaning up and stuff.  Really working hard.  I was a little envious maybe.  

When my server finally returned, I asked again for extra napkins and a carry out container.   

I've had better service at this IHOP in the past so I'll probably be back.  It's too convenient not to consider it.

This is a nice big clean Starbucks on Canal around a lot of busy hotels. There was only one person in line in front of me. The girl started ringing me up, stopped in the middle and got someone else since she was going on break. That person started ringing me up then stopped halfway and said someone else needed to train on the register. During this time two people behind me were rang up on the other register which was frustrating since I had my toddler with me and needed to get in and get out. I finally got my drink and it wasn't very good. Tasted like their shots are burnt and there wasn't enough flavoring. Definitely didn't stop by any more on the rest of my trip.

The atmosphere is very nice. Extra large dinning room to accommodate a crowd or lots of guests with a big convention in town. There is a long bar with a few TVs playing sports. Service was excellent. We stopped in for a late dinner of apps, drinks and dessert. We weren't disappointed, though I would recommend this place more for a business meeting than a dinner date. The wine list is enough for people to make a visit for drinks and good conversation if you're in the area. The food was good, but I feel like every restaurant in this area has good food. Bonus of this place is the size of the restaurant, interesting wine list, exceptional service, and nice atmosphere.
It looks like a tourist trap, but the food and music is great. We were really glad we went in.

This is a super cute place for a date! Quiet atmosphere and really quaint. Lots of options for dessert and tea. This is a chain from New York. They just opened four days ago. Worth giving a try if you are in the area!
A great place to eat and they have great shopping options.  A must do for lunch.  Try the roast beef crosssant sandwich with avacado and a peanut butter cookie...great duo.

We ordered 2 cinnamon brown sugar donuts & 1 cookies & cream. They were hot & fresh as described on the menu... Extremely light & fluffy! 
We also ordered the sticky bun donut (fancy donut), also very yummy. 

We preferred the hot & fresh donuts!
Went for brunch and had a great time! The service was great and food tasted wonderful! Had the steak sandwich and a Bloody Mary which were both great. Definitely coming back again to try more!

had a great time at the watch party triple D was at Noble pie midtown Reno beer was cold pizza was delicious wings were delicious garlic knots with forgot that was delicious
had a great time

I'm a Nashville native and used to go to The Melting Pot for special occasions. I returned with my husband and 4 friends over the weekend. Putting aside the dated atmosphere, the meal was horrible. We had a bug on our veggie and bread plate for the cheese fondue. We had a hair on two different dishes, both raw meat for the entrees. The waitress was very new and turned on an entree oil mix prematurely (as the raw meat took awhile to deliver) and it boiled and popped up from the pot, almost burning us. We dipped our meats in it, and it burnt the meats. We begged a nearby waitress for help and she at first insisted it was our fault. The manager then showed, and when we informed him of the issues, did not seem well trained in customer service. (He did later give us all a discount on our bill. I asked him for it.) I dislike writing negative reviews and do not frequently do so, but it was not a pleasant dining experience and it was not cheap. Overall, the cheese fondue and dessert fondue were tasty, but we would not return.

One of the best dining experiences my husband and I can remember.
Jason our waiter went through the experience and dishes and really made our time there more then enjoyable.

The Food? Out of this world. We shared several dishes and each was more delicious then the last. Most memorable was the Asparagus cream soup (surprising, I know) but I could drink that soup till I pop. It was a special, so I really hope they make it a regular dish. 

If you are in the area it's a definite must for dinner. Happy to hear they might open up closer to us in Manhattan. Just hope the quality of service makes it over too.

We were very worried based on many bad Yelp reviews for bad service. It was our anniversary and last year we were in the Montelpulciano di Abbruzzo region for our anniversary so we decided to come here anyway to see for ourselves. We are so glad we did. The food, service and ambiance was fabulous and we are so glad we came. This is one of the best restaurant experiences we have ever had in Philly.

Awesome place. The best place to explore new foods. You can't go wrong by making your own 4 course meal with multiple vendors in one place. Explore the Indian street foods at Tava and stop my the Mac & moons on the way out for a quick dessert for a quick snack.

Back in Reno and Squeeze in is as good as I remember. We ordered mimosas that come in large goblets (beware) and had the racy Tracy omelette and biscuits and gravy. Staff is always super friendly and food comes out fast.

Crust and cheese were solid, but the sauce is really holding this pizza back from being good. I was very disappointed with the sauce. It needs more seasoning, because the pizza is really plain otherwise. 

Salt and pepper goes a long way!

We had been wanting to try this place for at least a year. We love ramen and to be able to get it and sushi all in a drive through was interesting. We saw the good reviews and had high expectations. We had two types of ramen, three types of sushi and crab Rangoon. 

Everything was meh at best. 

I'm glad we tried it. We're glad it seems to be staying busy. We always hope for things to succeed in the area. 

But we will not have any reason to go back ourselves.
What a Marti Gras tradition. The chicory coffee and Beignets at this place where awesome. Luckily they where not busy when we stopped in. Great history and atmosphere.

First time with wife and son.  Will definitely return.  Started with spring rolls.  Large and stuffed with shrimp,  cilantro,  carrots, etc.  
Ginger stir fry, spicy salmon and pineapple fried rice followed.  Very, very tasty!  
Try the bubble tea!  I had watermelon..

Dont understand what the hype is about. I ordered a large sweet chilli boneless wings. It tastes like spicy sesame chicken? It was more fried batter than chicken. Definitely not what I was expecting wings to be. Way over priced too.

The veggie omelette was amazing, I definitely will try this place again.  I recommend everyone to try this place. I came across this place, while visiting at the Hampton Inn down the street. The breakfast food is way better than the Hampton Inn food.

People who work in this Burger King simply do not understand the language. Pretty hard to communicate with someone about what do you want to order if someone does not understand what are you talking about.

After a rather long evening at the museum I found myself heading out to eat. Zorba's was chosen. The souvlaki was overly garlic seasoned but tasty. Rice was cold and replaced . Vegetables were a bit skimpy. The hummus was phoned in and dull. Bread that came with the meal was very delicious. Service was efficient and the place was clean. The restaurant needs a serious makeover as it was absurdly dated. This is a popular place but most of what I wanted to order was sold out by 9pm on a Wednesday night which was annoying. It's BYOB but I did not bring a bottle. They could do better frankly. It's not 1984
We loved the Malai Kofta and Chicken Curry. Great service and atmosphere. Perfect spice level. We will be back!
Server said chicken was shredded. It was not. Portion was small Greek salad also small for a double portion of salad very blah. For 14.00 it was not worth the money.

We were shopping in the area and came in because of the good reviews.  The restaurant was large and clean. My hubby is not a fan of counter-service restaurants, but we decided to give it try. I love the creative menu, but the names make it hard to remember what we ordered.  We opted for their version of a Cobb salad, plus the first burger on their menu. Here's where things get interesting. The menu is great at explaining the sizes of the salads (small will feed one or two), and burgers can be ordered in various sizes. They offer potato salad or cole slaw for eat-in orders.  They also note on the menu that you can substitute any dressing for your salad. 

When we placed our order, we definitely felt rushed, although they were not busy when we went in.  Apparently they "dress" the burger in the kitchen so you have to commit to lettuce tomato pickles onions mustard catsup in advance.  Which is a shame because we split our burgers, and we each like different things.  So we got it plain.  I did request the jalapeño Caesar dressing, and it came on the side.  I also ordered a bottle of real coke. I asked if the onion rings were made in-house, but they were frozen, so we passed. 

We waited a while for the orders... the salad and burger were great, but no potato salad or coleslaw - I guess you had to ask for it.  They forgot theCoke. Had to go back and ask for that too. Note - they did put the grilled onions on the side- not sure why they didn't offer to put the other items there...

First of all let me just say we got lucky & didn't have an enormous wait time! seating is available outside although i'd love to see indoor seating in the future. the salmon came with huge portions & was seasoned perfectly. mac & cheese was decent cabbage was fair. my husband raved about the shrimp & i tried his yams which were def delicious & not too sweet at all! would def return in the future.

First time trying a Philly Cheesesteak and it was AMAZING. Ordered one with sweet peppers and onion. They slice the steak per order and the portions are huge. I ordered the small one, but they also have a large version too. This place is only about 10-15 minutes from the airport and I would recommend stopping by if you are in the area. Only downside is there is little seating to eat so you will likely have to take it to go. They have a couple picnic tables outside, and nothing on the inside.

Bada Boom!!!!
Got off the plane with the family and headed over HBs on 8th and it was AWESOME!!!!!   Nashville Hot, oh yah!!! if your in Nashville and absolute MUST....
Had 10 Togo entrees once, Gave me 1 bag of chips I asked for 2 more, it was company "policy" 1 bag per to go order. I told the cashier woman to use her common sense. Never been back since.

My wife and I pass this place all the time near the mall and always wondered about it.  We finally went in because my wife was in the mood for onigiri and we saw they had it. It came and it was so good we wanted more. We also got red bean dim sum which was also delicious along with the ramen. The prices we very reasonable and staff friendly. Only thing holding it back from 5 stars is it seemed like they brought the food out whenever they wanted not all at the same time. They brought my wife's ramen out like 5 minutes before mine. Anyway we will be back next time we are in the mood for ramen.
This was our first visit and our server Caty was great! I had the very tasty Farm house Hash with onions avocado, peppers and potatoes topped with 2 eggs.

Nestled in a little neighborhood near the Hi-Pointe and AMC movie theaters and just down the road from the first Kaldi's Coffee location, this restaurant is in a walkable area with little stores and shops (complete with even a small candy store)! 

My partner and I have been going here for years, and she raves about their mac and cheese. Having an all-vegan restaurant can be hard to find in the midwest, let alone one open as late as this one, but it's great to know that places like Seedz are an option for movie-goers like ourselves.

I tend to go for the sandwiches, which are all pretty great. My favorite so far has been the LTA, which is a vegan take on the BLT, with lettuce, tempeh, and avocado. Most come with chips and a small side salad.

The place is small, so get there in the off-time to get a good seat. Otherwise, it's a great place to grab a meal, then take a walk in the nearby park!

Great casual food. There is a propensity for a large amount outdoor dining available. I had the French toast - I never thought French toast made with ciabatta bread would be successful but because they fill it with batter it's amazing. The blackened salmon sauce was to die for. I also had a kale hash that had Brussels sprouts and I thought it would taste as healthy as it sounds but it was fresh and delicious. The place is recommended!

Dropped my car off at Dick Norris and decided to try Joey's. Great first impression due to the rustic brick and wood design with a cool wine bottle wall. The surroundings were very clean just after a lunch surge. The classic 40s, 50's pop and rat pack crooner music projected a New York style vibe to it with a light "Goodfellas" ambiance to it. My server, Nikki,  was friendly, hospitable, and so helpful.

 I ordered the two slice Neopolitan lunch special and added toppings with Nikki's help. The meatballs for the pizzas are made in the morning, frozen, then sliced mandolin thin as a great topping. I took one to zone in on the taste. Great flavor! The onions and spinach were sauteed then topped the 'za! Sooo tasty! I love black olives and they covered the slices! In fact, all toppings covered. I made it a point to try a stripped cheese and sauce bite. The tomato flavor was wonderful, cheese delish, and the crispy flavorful crust made a killer NY slice! Best I've tasted in my local area! THIS  is why I really broke the slice down! The proof is in the "'za"! Joey's is 1.5 miles from my house! I'll be ordering in house and take out! A great surprise in my area of the hood!

I can't believe I've never written a review for Butcher Bar. This is probably my favorite restaurant in the city. I used to call myself a whiskey drinker but then I turned 30 and if I open a bottle of liquor without the intention of putting it in a hot cuppa for a toddy, I need to cancel all my plans for the following day because one whiff can give me a hangover. 

But BEFORE that, I tried Butcher Bar (which prides itself on being a whiskey bar, to my knowledge) and was totally upsold on an Angel's Envy Old Fashioned that was to die for. That same night I was upsold from the typical burger to the bison burger or whatever that $22 burger is made of. I think my meal (only one drink) was $50 and my boyfriend's was $15 that night. But we were both equally happy with what we got. 

We've also come in for happy hour and had that lovely, creamy mac n cheese and the crispy (duck?) wings.

I came in another time with a couple friends from out of town and they noticed the Trough on the menu. We decided we'll have to try it some day. Fast forward to now, 6 months later, AND PEOPLE, WE DONE DID IT.

The Trough has to be ordered in advance with a deposit because it's a ton of meat and such. Setting my reservation and getting the deposit in was a bit of a hassle if I'm being 100% because the hostess first had me down on the wrong date and then they emailed me a form asking for a lot of personal information so I just decided to walk in on my lunch break and make sure the reservation was set

Food was 3 stars but one star for the staff.  Staff really needs to improve their attitude (she yelled at my boyfriend when he asked for water which she should have brought it up anyways!) 

Also soap was watered down which did not do its job! Come on! I will never go back!

Happy hour shrimp and fries are half off which is a great deal. That makes the shrimp $5 and the fries $1.50 and it's a big basket! Pitchers are half off but be careful because it's domestic beer and the bartender didn't warn us when we ordered a Summer Shandy pitcher and paid full price when we thought it would be half off.  Also have to be sitting at the bar for happy hour prices! It's a beautiful view and we saw a dolphin. Very casual and laid back. We'd definitely come back for happy hour

This is an excellent sandwich shop. I'm not one for cheesesteaks normally but they way they spice their meat is amazing. They only issue is that they don't have mushrooms or other toppings for their subs. I think it's only whiz and onions. Part of me thinks "why change a good thing?" But personally it would have been nice to have some options. Besides that, each and every time, I've had pleasant and kind service. They're normally busy but not packed which I also like.

It was louder than I thought it would be so it was kind of hard to get work done. They do have free wifi and its a nice atmosphere. Chairs are wooden, not good to sit in for long periods of time. I just got a muffin and it was really good. Good place overall.
Nice quaint coffee & tea shop. A hidden gem. Enjoyed the food and drink. I got the mudslide which is a mix of espresso, hot chocolate and marshmallows. I absolutely love their outside area.

This place is amazing and the guy who's always there is so nice. I originally was told by a friend to check out this place down the street so as I was headed there to pick up something to go I realized they were closed on Tuesdays so I was like let me find somewhere else near  by, and thank god I did because I had one of the best lobster raviolis I've ever had before here. There salads are also amazing as is the insalata caprese. So my first time there I rolled up and went to go pay because he didn't ask me for any card info on the phone and the guy was like "its okay your good". I was so surprised so I was like " what its free why??" And he said its just something they do sometimes, so it was definitely meant to be me going there and not the other place. Ive also had the salmon fettuccine to and that's pretty good as well. Everything's good there but especially the lobster ravioli. Great people great place.

There are quite a few of these "build your own" type burrito esque places. Many are good but Baja Burrito is really good! Yes, there seems to always be a line. With good reason! There parking is crazy, the lot is small. The inside isn't much bigger. It feels like you have to work to get in there and eat but do not be discouraged, there is a great reward! 
We went with a fairly large group, there was a line, but it moved fairly quickly. When we completed our line time, we were able to find a table for all of us together. Staff is very friendly and it feels like we work together to assemble our food. I went with the Fish Tacos (3 in the basket). They were delicious.(period) Quite filling so I brought one home for lunch the following day. Everyone else in our party was equally pleased! 
Worth the effort!
Amazing service, very nice people and haven't had service this good in a while. 10/10 would recommend. Great food too

We made reservations and had a 39 year and 6 year wedding anniversary in our party and made sure they were aware. We arrived 10 minutes early. We were seated on time. Our waiter got to work late. We were served okay but not great. Servers kept bringing us drinks ordered by other tables. When our food arrived, the servers had no clue who ordered what. My meal was served late and they gave me a filet mignon when I ordered top sirloin.  No one congratulated us on our anniversaries. We just sort of thought they would . So overall mediocre experience. The food was cooked very well. The servers dropped the ball.
Best place to eat drink and play also clean and follows safety guidelines for COVID-19

We had a great curbside pick up experience and lunch from this restaurant last weekend. My parents were visiting so I set up a table outside so we could have a social distanced lunch. I called Salt + Smoke directly from their phone # on their Facebook page.  In case you didn't know, if you order through the Yelp GrubHub online system, they take a percentage of that sale away from the small business. Also, if you call the restaurant from the number on Yelp instead of going to Google or the restaurants Facebook page to get the phone number, it's tied to GrubHub and they still  a commission. Small businesses are struggling enough as it is. Whenever possible just call the restaurant directly using their phone number on Facebook. 

My parents arrived to pick up the order Curbside and it was ready on time but I called and added a pulled pork sandwich and french fries for my son at the last minute and they had that ready for my parents in less than five minutes and they were on their way to me.

We ordered a couple of racks of ribs, salmon, potato salad, coleslaw, pulled pork sandwich, deviled eggs, and french fries. The ribs meals came with pop overs that were hot and fresh. All of the food was wonderful - the hot food was hot & the cold food was cold. We like their sweet barbecue sauce but honestly the food didn't need it and it was great without it. I like their dry rub on the ribs because it's not too salty. We will definitely continue to order from this restaurant and support t

A great fun place to hang out, socialize, drink wine, and be merry!

I ordered a flight of 5 wines for $14. I ordered the Sweet Blueberry, Key West Lime, Strawberry Riesling, Peach Chardonnay, and the Tangerine Tango. My favorite was the Tangerine Tango. They were all great though!

These people are racist!! There was a Sign in front of me that said "please wait to be seated." I waited 8 minutes to be seated and the hostess tells us we can be seated anywhere. The next guest arrives after us and immediately seated and their table was wiped and sanitized for them. Then we waited five more minutes and asked for a menu, which was then thrown at us by another waitress. Please note there were two of us and only one menu was given on a slow day. We just got up and walked away! Poor service!

This place is a must try and even more so if you think you dont like Indian cuisine, or if you have never had it. And if you love Indian food, you will be in heaven. 

I arrived torn on menu items to order, and was delighted when the server mentioned the buffet. She took me over and showed me what was vegetarian, vegan, and meat of course. I was all in! I will admit, I tried just about everything vegetarian and vegan. The taste was out of this world. I had three plates of food and typically cant finish a plate when dining. 

The buffet was very clean and well maintained. Customers also wear gloves when getting their food, which I loved. That should be a standard at every buffet. 

The restaurant was clean, service was great, and the food was impressive. I am ashamed I have never eaten here until today. Five stars all the way!
This placeIs the best, the prices are amazing and the food and the portions are just incredible. Visit here often and always bring people to it when they come to town.
Came in for lunch on a very slow Saturday afternoon. We were seated and given water then ignored for 20 minutes with no one coming to take our order so we left. Very disappointed in the service.

They originally messed up my order but they were quick to fix it and very apologetic about the mistake. The food was absolutely amazing too! We would most certainly return here when we're in the area again!
We finally found our favorite boba place in town. Thank you for staying open. Love their brown sugar milk!

Great cheesesteak in Fishtown. Meat is good, cheese is good, and bread is great. Nice and soft yet strong enough to hold everything together. I'm a big fan of their pickle and pepper station.

The fries were okay. I got take out and they probably would've been better at the store so that's not their fault. I paid extra dollar for some whiz on the side and have zero regrets.

Overall, this stuff is great drunk or sober. No need to hit the madness at Pat's or Geno's to get the best cheesesteak.

Had the fried chicken sandwich (Otis Redding) medium spicy at the Fried Chicken Festival and it is the best chicken out here. I am sold on this place. Most of the time, festival food is not that great but this place is the real deal. As a local, I hate that I am just now finding this place but I guess...better late than never. Do your taste buds a favor and try this place.

We were in the neighborhood and not crazy about the other Moe's so decided to give it a try.  We had to walk out because of people making our food without masks over their noses.  How hard is it to wear your mask properly?  So disappointed!

This place is AWESOME.  Definitely a place for adults as much as kids!  The drinks are great, and everything we had for food was delicious.  A great place for groups of both adults and kids to get together and enjoy time together.
Delicious chicken tikki masala. Was pricy and small portions but it was ok because of the great quality

Maybe I am crazy, but I felt this place was a bit over-hyped.
The interior could use some sprucing up, but wasn't awful. 

They definitely offer different pancake options that suit every pancake lover's individual desire. We ordered the pecan pancakes as well as the cherry supreme. The Pecan pancakes left something to be desired. The batter was well done, but I was just expecting more flavor overall. 

The cherry supreme was definitely the better out of the two, these were unique and packed in a lot of flavor but were so incredibly sweet that is was more of a dessert than breakfast. 

We had been advised to arrive as soon as this placed opened or expect a 2 hour wait, even on a Friday morning. We arrived around 6:15 am and were one of the first people in the restaurant. We definitely didn't need to wake up before the sunrise to get in line, but this might change on a Saturday or Sunday. By the time we left, there was a small line forming outside. 

Don't get me wrong, nothing was bad necessarily- just overhyped for what it turned out to be. I would not wait over 20 minutes to eat here and if I were to come again I would try some different flavors as well as their savory options. 

3.4/5

I ate here for my birthday with my daughter. The food is mediocre but the 2 strawberry cheesecakes that cost us just shy of 19 bucks was delicious!!! The price of 2 people was 63 bucks for lunch menu items as well. I'd only revisit for a slice on a special occasion but not any day.

Johhny Rockets, it's been way too long. I love you long time. Double patty bacon cheddar burger with a extra slice of pepperjack. Opted for tater tots instead of fries. #thetatertotlife

Tried out the chocolate peanut butter  #shake, just not my jam. Gotta stay with team #chocolate.

Second day back for the #Reno  @johnnyrockets #crew and our waitress was spot on perfect. They were closed the entire shutdown because of the casino location. We tipped out 75% and she was in tears of joy. 
Take a look around. YOU can make another persons day. A whole lot of people need that #humantouch and a super FAT  Tip!!!!
Best calamari I've ever had in my life. Top notch service as well. We loved it so much we went back the next night!

Best Fra Diavolo in the city! I've been searching for good Fra Diavolo ever since my trip to Boston. Obviously nothing in Phillly will compare to Boston, but I was looking for the next best thing and that's Pietro's. Good portion size at a great price. Taste way better than other Italian restaurants that charge twice as much! As for the pizza, never disappoints.

This is my neighborhood Wawa that I frequent daily. That doesn't mean I like it, it's just convenient. Little parking that is always full due to the busy location. You are always greeted by panhandlers before you even step into the place. Sometimes there's even ambulances and police out front for some reason or another. People are packed inside a small location like sardines in a can. I hope you don't need to use the bathroom because there isn't one. The customer service is sometimes there (I'm familiar with a few people up front) but normally not. I feel like the girls behind the sandwich station are always rude and unprofessional. I understand working in food service can be overwhelming (I do it too) especially at a busy location, but you have to be nice. Food quality is hit or miss. I feel as though popular menu items with few modifications are made well but as soon as you order something they don't see as often, it's most likey to be ruined. I have often received wilted lettuce and sandwiches explosive with mayonnaise. Does the "little bit of mayo" mean nothing to you guys? Sometimes I receive something completely different from what I ordered. Just last week I got my fiancee a chicken tender hoagie for dinner and the chicken wasn't even cooked! They are always keeping it interesting. Today I walked in sad that hoagiefest has come to a close but siptopia is here so I thought I'd treat myself to one of those fancy beverages I never order. It's good to try new things, right

We flew into Tampa and were wildly hungry before hitting the road for a long drive... so glad to find this awesome food truck. I got the #6 and my wife got the #2. The guys behind the counter were super helpful in my questions about ingredients for food allergies. The sandwiches were delicious. I especially appreciated how the packaging was cardboard and paper. Thanks for the sustainability in to-go! Highly recommend coming by this yummy spot.

Now that restaurants are closed, it is a new way of dining from a restaurant and I was glad that Zinburger makes that possible.  IN addition they offer 35% off your order plus 50% off beer and wine.  You can order online or by calling or you can drive up and be waited on.  They will have your meal ready in about 20 minutes.  If you want to do curbside pickup, when you order you give your car model and color and they will bring it right out when you drive up-worked great.

I got the Hamburger that comes with applewood bacon, cheese and a sauce.  You let them know how you want it cooked and mine was cooked just right.  It's a big burger and delicious.  I also got sweet potato fries that come with ranch dressing.  I ordered a wedge salad with dressing on the side and it came as requested.  The burger gets pretty messy-I should have put on a bib!  However, worth every bite.  Fries were also delicious and I'm saving the salad for later.  

When you order, you can add a tip and I recommend you do so to keep the workers employed and the restaurant open.  It's good to know that you can still enjoy the same meals as when you eat in the restaurant and it is easy to pick it up.

We went in thinking this place would be great because I deliver food for a living and there's always a line of people. Sadly the food was kind of bland and the dessert was as well. Don't get the hype.

Quality has been consistent and awesome for the 10+ years I've been coming here. Best bagels in Reno by far and the flavored coffee choices are plentiful! Muffins never disappoint. Staff is always friendly, helpful, and cheery even when the line is out the door-which it often is on the weekends-but moves quickly! They have a new rewards program that gives you things like free coffee or dollar amounts off your order, it's super convenient and sends you text alerts when you've got a new perk! Favorite breakfast place in Reno, keep it up!

I have been going to this place and I must say the food is really good. The service in the drive up window on the others hand is not very good. This is the 2nd time they have messed my order up the first time they got it wrong I order a Santa Barbra char and they gave me a regular burger  witch I called on since I live 20 mile out of town and just today I ordered the Santa Barbra Cobb salad an sure enough they forgot the dressing. I know ordering one item is a tuff thing to take care of . But i just wanted to let you know if you go through the drive thru make sure you get the order that you ordered.

Second time I've been to Tony's and I haven't done a review for the first time! Shame on me!!! I went 4 months ago for my birthday and couldn't believe how incredible it was!! My dad got jealous so asked me to take him for his birthday. He didn't have to twist my arm very hard. It's of course fine dining, darker interior but beautiful. Everyone in both experiences have been kind and genuine. The steaks are outstanding. I've ordered the bone in filet each time with garlic butter but I have promised myself to branch out next time. Ordered the Mac n cheese and sweet potatoes the first time. Excellent!!! Sweet potatoes were like a dessert, seriously! Ordered the creamed spinach because it's my favorite thing to order at a steak house. The server warned me there was a licorice taste but I ordered it anyway and couldn't eat it. I ended up getting the mashed potatoes which were probably very simple but delicious anyway. My dad was surprised with a brûlée cheesecake that was out of this world!!!! I love it here!! #1 steakhouse for me in Indy

Brunch at Harpers Garden was the perfect cure for the Sunday blues. Our personal greenhouse dining room provided a relaxed, warm environment without feeling too isolated. The list of creative specialty cocktails had something for everyone. The menu was the perfect mix of sweet and savory dishes, manageable portions and the most delicate, perfectly poached eggs. Our waiter, Mathias, treated us like old friends. He was energetic, funny, kind and entertaining. We can't wait to go back!

We had a baby shower here for about 25 people and couldn't be happier. The food and drinks were great, top notch service and all guests had a great time. Parking was not an issue at all. We had the liquid art corner space and were able to decorate. Mike and staff ensured we had everything we needed and we were able to plan it ahead of time from long distance. We highly recommend it.
Food is priced fairly. Service quality depends on the waiter. I went there twice - one occasion service was fair and the second occasion service was great.
The drink specials are a god deal. I like the hot and glory wings. My son likes the kids meal ribs and Mac n cheese. Good place for a game or some wings and a drink.

Needed a good Mexican restaurant.  El Mariachi was open.  
I ordered the Chicken Tostadas.  Chicken was bland and tasteless.
Free nachos included they too were flavorless. ‍‍

I doubt I will return.

The is a great little hidden spot. It is inside the plaza so don't leave if you can't find it the sign has a little lime on it. We ordered the barria tacos and they were delicious with cheese. We had the fries burritos and it was good if we had ate it fresh it might have been better as the fries were a little soggy and I think crispy fries would have set it off. We got the churros and they were fried a little too hard but were still good. We also got the elote but it was a little too liquify but if less liquid it would have been great. Would recommend and try other items.
Best Vietnamese in town. I love the Bhan mi sandwich with a rare beef pho. For two people to eat here it's $20 totall. I'm definitely coming back here soon.

Very disappointed in the food and service. To start we ordered a pitcher of margaritas and a large Queso dip when we sat down. It took what seemed like 30 minutes to get the pitcher and the queso never came even after asking where it was several times. I ordered chili toreadors and got a small cup of pickled jalapeños. 
My wife ordered a Mexican pizza with guacamole and sour cream on the side and it came with neither. 
We ordered a second pitcher of margaritas and we finished our food with empty glasses so cancelled it. Asked for a manager and did not get one. We will not be back to Carmelitas.

Amazing margaritas and delicious food. Don't miss out on this place!

We started with chips and guac, entrees included tacos and I got their chicken torta. The tortas are BIG; half was plenty for lunch and I had the rest later in the day for dinner. We did the classic margarita pitcher and the whole table enjoyed more than one glass (we had 4 people). We went on a Saturday afternoon and walked in and didn't have to wait.
The food was cold. Flavorless. My side Greek salad was wilted and have considerable browning. I won't be ordering from them again
